description:
• Owned end-to-end test strategy and execution for core modules, aligning with Agile sprints and release timelines to ensure high-quality deliveries
• Developed and maintained automated test suites using Selenium WebDriver, Playwright, Mocha, and JavaScript, achieving 65%+ automation coverage
• Led migration from Selenium (Mocha + JS) to Playwright, improving execution speed, reliability, and cross-browser testing while reducing flaky tests
• Designed scalable, reusable automation frameworks using OOP and functional programming, enhancing maintainability and extensibility
• Built API automation using Playwright's APIRequestContext, enabling end-to-end validation of UI and backend workflows
• Integrated automation into CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins and GitHub Actions, reducing regression cycle time and enabling continuous testing
• Applied AI-assisted automation to generate test cases, page objects, and scripts by analyzing DOM structure and user workflows
• Implemented dynamic test creation by crawling page structures and embedding business logic, improving coverage and reducing manual effort
• Used Chrome DevTools and AI-driven insights for debugging, network analysis, and faster root cause identification
• Performed performance testing using Artillery, validating system scalability, response times, and reliability under load
• Reduced manual testing effort by 45% through automation and optimized test data and test case management strategies
• Mentored junior QA engineers via code reviews, framework guidance, and training on automation best practices
• Collaborated with cross-functional teams to improve release quality and accelerate defect resolution

• Designed and maintained comprehensive test cases, test plans, and documentation to ensure full test coverage, traceability, and alignment with business requirements
• Conducted User Acceptance Testing (UAT) for enterprise clients, validating software readiness and ensuring successful production deployments
• Collaborated with key clients including Blackbox, HDFC Ergo, Zuventus Healthcare, Bangalore Airport, Engage2Excel, LPL Financial, Tata Motors, Tata Technologies, and Wipro
• Developed and executed automated test scripts using Selenium (Java, JavaScript), Python (Pytest), and Cypress, improving test efficiency, reliability, and reducing manual effort
• Performed database validation using MySQL, ensuring data accuracy, integrity, and consistency across applications
• Executed functional, regression, and system testing, validating application behavior across multiple scenarios and environments
• Identified, analyzed, and debugged defects using strong problem-solving and root cause analysis skills, reducing defect leakage and improving product quality
• Collaborated with cross-functional teams (Developers, Product Managers, DevOps) to resolve issues and enhance overall software quality
• Monitored system performance using Grafana and Prometheus, proactively identifying bottlenecks and ensuring system stability
• Managed and maintained CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, enabling seamless integration and execution of automated test suites
• Utilized Git for version control, ensuring efficient collaboration, code management, and traceability of changes

• Conducted UAT and End-to-End testing for clients including L&T Technology Services, Inmobi, Bluestar India, Black Box, HTC Inc, Infogain, Bristlecone, Hyundai Capital Canada, Firstsource, LPL Financial, and others
• Designed comprehensive test plans, test cases, and test execution strategies, ensuring alignment with product requirements and client expectations
• Executed manual and automated tests across multiple platforms and devices, utilizing tools such as BrowserStack, LambdaTest, and Zephyr Squad
• Validated software quality at various stages of development, including component, API, feature, and end-to-end testing
• Performed cross-browser and cross-device testing across multiple operating systems
• Collaborated with development, product, and customer support teams to streamline defect resolution and optimize product quality
• Coordinated closely with developers to report, track, and analyze defects, providing actionable insights to enhance software reliability
• Utilized JIRA for test management, defect tracking, and progress monitoring
• Analyzed application logs, generated detailed test reports, and produced escaped defect tracking reports to improve testing effectiveness

• Gained hands-on experience in various testing types, including Functional, UI/UX, Acceptance, Blackbox, Regression, Integration, and End-to-End testing
• Utilized MySQL to validate front-end data against the database
• Developed an understanding of requirement gathering and test planning processes
• Conducted testing on an Employee Engagement Product with redemption features
• Became familiar with SDLC processes and Agile methodologies
• Enhanced expertise in Non-functional Testing, Manual Testing, and additional QA-related skills
